commands_used: answer 1. I am Toh-Wo, a Secret-Speaker of the Toh-Reel-Ka, the Xeech-Leel secret warriors. We hunt the Eye of Argonia, a jewel that can heal sick Hist, at the Root under the sea, before the Unbound cult of Cuts-the-Old-Knot gets there. The marker stone shows seven towers, one cut deeper. 2. Go to Bell Station and ask Meer-Tasi, the steward, which drowned spire the stone marks. Sees-Below is also marked. 3. Talk to Meer-Tasi or Sees-Below; my Fort Chalkmoth errand can wait or come first. 4. I do not understand what the Root and Eye really are, or what moans in the Chalkmoth cellar. I could find out by asking people and exploring.

answer 1. Meer-Tasi identified the cut tower as Teku-Sul Spire, drowned near Lilmoth, with a great gate of three empty sockets that nobody has forced and a priest ghost before it. 2. Dive to Teku-Sul and find the great gate, via the Teku-Sul Halls doors. 3. Sneak past or fight the priests attendants; I am Argonian so I may breathe water (not certain); otherwise buy waterbreathing from Meer-Tasi. 4. I do not know what the three sockets need (I carry a disc, keystone and eye-setting, maybe those), nor who Sul-Xeeth the ghost is; I can find out by going there and talking.

answer 1. The ghost of Sul-Xeeth told me the Kings Gate needs three seal-stones, no fewer: one in the warden vault at Blackrose Prison, one in the flooded vaults of Gemin, one in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl. Behind the gate is the way to the Root and the Eye. 2. Go tell Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom. 3. I could report first as the journal says, or go after a stone myself; I can also sneak or fight. 4. I do not know where Gemin or Vorannuhl are, or what is in Blackrose vault; Never-Writes-Twice may know.

answer 1. Quest done: I reported to Never-Writes-Twice, was promoted to Reel-Ka, and got armour and 300 gold. The order must take all three seal-stones before the Unbound. 2. Fetch the stones from Blackrose Prison, Gemin and Vorannuhl, then open the gate at Teku-Sul. 3. Any order; Blackrose is least dangerous, Vorannuhl the worst; sneak or fight. Fort Chalkmoth is my side errand. 4. I do not know what the Root and Eye truly are, what moans in the Chalkmoth cellar, or who the Collector is.

answer I am Toh-Wo, now Reel-Ka of the Toh-Reel-Ka, with Reel-Ka cuirass and helm, rapier, about 1350 gold, lockpicks, 3 Grey Seals, 3 Unbound Seals, Recipe for the Seal, Pale Harvest key, disc, keystone, eye-setting. Bell Station steward Meer-Tasi named Teku-Sul Spire as the cut tower; its great gate needs three seal-stones, per the ghost Sul-Xeeth: one in the Blackrose Prison warden vault, one in the flooded vaults of Gemin, one in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl. All three are marked on my map; Blackrose is the easiest, Vorannuhl the worst. Never-Writes-Twice wants all three before the Unbound get them. Still unknown: what the Root and Eye really are, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, and who the Collector is.
